newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: Namibian stocks week - Namibia Breweries features.
newsitem.headline: Namibian stocks week - Namibia Breweries features.

text.p: Namibia Breweries dominated the stock exchange last week with a total of more than two million shares bought and sold (total value N$5.1 million) although the price dropped on Friday to N$2.45 after starting the week at N$2.50.
Namibian Sea Products also fell, down to 66 cents a share (from 69 cents) for only 30,000 shares traded.
Barlows edged up during the week on trading on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange after some N$1.5 million worth of shares were traded on the Namibian Stock Exchange (NSE) on Monday and Tuesday.

The total vaule traded during the week was N$7.8 million, with a volume of 2,185,500 shares traded. The NSE overall index was virtually unchanged and ended the week at 223.33 (down from the previous Friday's close of 223.72).
The NSE local index ended at 148.17 (down from 148.78).
